I am pleased to let you know that two new "versions" of LISP
have appeared at SAIL.

1) A single segment version that in theory will grow to 256K
2) A single segment version that starts at 256K and allocates
    memory as if it was on a paging system, thus giving you
    the advantages of the ITS/TOPS-20 binary program space
    allocation scheme.

It is probably possible to make these for Tops-10, though it has not been
tried yet, and I understand that CMU is interested.

It may also be possible to support KL10 VM.  If there
is interest in this project, then please let me know
personnaly, and perhaps we can work something out.

--howard
